reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing getScheduledAmount, which every consumer already calls.

duplication.why: Removes the two rounding variants (and the roundSumBeforeDividing flag) so a single range rule remains.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the scheduled-amount definition lives.

scope.why: Rule change, dropping the now-meaningless flag at its one caller, comment updates and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Simplifies the helper's interface by deleting a variation that no longer exists; the null case is now typed.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All consumers go through getScheduledAmount; schedule-template keeps a harmless op === 'isbetween' guard around the call.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by schedules/app.ts, forecast-schedules, schedule-template, preview and desktop-client.
